meta.name: daily
meta.description: Use at the start of a working day (or when the user asks "what should I focus on today / give me my brief / daily standup"). Produces a one-screen daily brief — today's top 3, open loops that need a nudge, what's slipping, and a suggested focus order. Trigger on "/daily", "daily brief", "what should I focus on today", "morning brief", "standup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
